svg.title: K15: Nobody set REDIS_PORT. Kubernetes did.
svg.desc: For a Service called redis, Kubernetes puts REDIS_PORT in every new Pod as a tcp URL. The worker reads REDIS_PORT as a number and fails on the URL.
